# developerhub_product_subscriptions (Data Source)

Lists Developer Hub product subscriptions (the "APIMgmt.Subscriptions" entity set - see DESIGN.md §5/§7/§9), optionally narrowed to one application or one product. Useful to see subscriptions created outside Terraform, for example by developers in the Developer Hub UI, and their current approval status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everyone subscribed to a product, including subscriptions developers
# created themselves in the Developer Hub UI, with their approval status.
data "developerhub_product_subscriptions" "sales_api" {
  product_name = "Sales_API"
}

output "pending_subscriptions" {
  value = [
    for s in data.developerhub_product_subscriptions.sales_api.subscription : s.application_id
    if !s.is_subscribed
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) If set, only subscriptions of this application are returned.
- `product_name` (String) If set, only subscriptions to this product (technical name) are returned.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed identifier ("product_subscriptions") for Terraform Plugin Framework data source convention.
- `subscription` (Attributes List) The subscriptions, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subscription))

<a id="nestedatt--subscription"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subscription`

Read-Only:

- `application_id` (String)
- `developer_id` (String)
- `id` (String) The SAP-assigned subscription id.
- `is_subscribed` (Boolean)
- `product_name` (String)
- `status` (String) SAP's own subscription status, passed through unvalidated (DESIGN.md §9).
